about: HomeGymRecs starter catalog (2026-10-24): home gym equipment: dumbbells (adjustable and fixed), racks (power racks, half racks, folding and wall-mounted racks, squat stands), benches, barbells, weight plates, machines (functional trainers, all-in-one trainers, cable towers, Smith machines, lat pulldowns, belt squats, leg presses) and cardio machines (rowers, air bikes, exercise bikes, ski ergs, treadmills). Every entry was read on 2026-10-24 from the maker's own store page linked in sources: REP Fitness, Titan Fitness, PowerBlock, Force USA, Ironmaster, Bowflex, Bells of Steel (which also sells Nüobell) and PRx Performance; Concept2 machines are read from REP Fitness, which sells them. Rogue Fitness is not in it yet: roguefitness.com answers automated reads with a CAPTCHA. Sorinex, Eleiko and Marcy were not read. One entry per model as the maker sells it; sizes, heights, depths, lb and kg versions and colours of one model are one entry, while versions sold under their own names stay separate (REP PR-4000 vs PR-5000, Bowflex SelectTech 552 vs 1090, PowerBlock Pro 50 vs Commercial Pro 50, Ironmaster Super Bench vs Super Bench PRO V2). Spec cells the maker's page doesn't state are blank.
